violations.text:
Accumulation of debris on exterior of warewashing machine.
Top of dish machine has chemical buildup

Bowl or other container with no handle used to dispense food.
In Parmesan cheese in walk in.
Bulk flour bin. Handle has broken off, no handle. Employee removed

Equipment in poor repair.
Torn gasket on reach in freezer

Opened employee beverage container in a cold holding unit with food to be served to customers.
Coffee in reach in cooler on cooks line. Educated employees

Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food.
Raw shelled eggs over sodas in walk in cooler

Equipment in poor repair.
Torn gasket on freezer

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Used as dump sink evidenced by ice

No proof provided that food employees are informed of their responsibility to report to the person in charge information about their health and activities related to foodborne illnesses.
2 new hires. Operator has forms and will have employees sign

No written procedures available for use of time as a public health control to hold time/temperature control for safety food.
Emailed form to operator

Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food.
Raw shelled eggs over bread in walk in cooler
No soap provided at handwash sink.

Dishmachine not washing/rinsing properly. Must wash, rinse and sanitize all dishware, equipment and utensils in three-compartment sink until dishmachine is functioning properly.
Operator is aware of machine not functioning properly and has work order in place. Will use 3CS until it is fixed.
Employee beverage container on a food preparation table or over/next to clean equipment/utensils.
Food storage container cracked.

Label on a food item prepared and packaged onsite for customer self-service does not include product identity/description, date product was packaged and name and address of the establishment that prepared and packaged the food.
Deserts at front counter in soda cooler

Raw animal food stored over or with unwashed produce.
Raw veal over onions in walk in cooler
Stop Sale issued on time/temperature control for safety food due to temperature abuse.

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spinach 51f. and ham 47f. double panned in pizza cooler.
Manager states it has been in cooler overnight

Time/temperature control for safety food identified in the written procedure as a food held using time as a public health control has no time marking and the time removed from temperature control cannot be determined. Pie made 1 hour ago. Manager added time mark.

Proof of required state approved employee training not available for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
